messages.subject: mirt vs. lavaan
parts:
Hello

I’m estimating a one-factor CFA model with both ‘mirt’ and ‘lavaan’ and the outputs are very different. Why doesn’t ‘mirt’ fix the loading of the first item to 1, as is common in CFA? Is there anything that I can do to make them closer? Or is the comparison totally wrong and the two packages are made for different purposes and on different grounds?

Best regards

Maya

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: mirt vs. lavaan
parts:
This is largely for numerical integration reasons as 0-1 scaling is easier to set up a grid for. If you want  the parameters to be more comparable, set the variance of the latent traits in lavaan to 1 and estimate the first slope. I hosted a simulation comparing the two packages, which you may find helpful: http://philchalmers.github.io/SimDesign/html/03-Parameter_recovery_simulation.html

Phil
